english.title: Fishing vessel owner fails to enter into fisherman's work agreement with fisherman
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), were the owner of a fishing vessel, namely **(..SPECIFY VESSEL..), on board which a fisherman, namely **(..SPECIFY FISHERMAN..), did not have a fisherman's work agreement which complied with regulations 9(1) and (2) and 29(1) of the Merchant Shipping (Work in Fishing Convention) Regulations 2018, in that **(..SPECIFY BREACH..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 8(3) and 29(1) of the Merchant Shipping (Work in Fishing Convention) Regulations 2018.
